title: Over in Glory
style: traditional Southern gospel hymn, old-time church piano, gentle Hammond organ, warm baritone male lead, four-part harmony quartet, 84 bpm, 3/4 waltz feel, reverent, nostalgic
negativeTags: 808, trap, EDM, synth, rap, autotune, rock
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Church piano)

[Verse 1]
I have walked these dusty roads for many a year
I have known the weight of sorrow, known the taste of tears
But the Savior walked beside me every mile
And He whispered, Child, just rest a little while

[Chorus]
(Quartet harmony)
Over in glory, there's a mansion bright
Where the weary find their rest and there is no night
I'll lay my burdens down by the crystal sea
Over in glory, Jesus waits for me

[Verse 2]
Mother sang the old songs by the kitchen fire
Daddy prayed on Sunday with the country choir
Now they've gone on over to that golden shore
And I know I'll see them standing at the door

[Chorus]
Over in glory, there's a mansion bright
Where the weary find their rest and there is no night
I'll lay my burdens down by the crystal sea
Over in glory, Jesus waits for me

[Bridge]
(Soft, spoken-sung)
When this race is over and my work is through
I'll go home rejoicing, Lord, to be with You

[Final Chorus]
(Full harmony, slight key lift)
Over in glory, there's a mansion bright
Where the weary find their rest and there is no night
I'll lay my burdens down by the crystal sea
Over in glory, Jesus waits for me

[Outro]
(Slow, held harmony)
Jesus waits for me
